en.quote: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?
en.riddle: What mean ye by these stones?
en.speaker: children

he.quote: לְמַעַן תִּֽהְיֶה זֹאת אוֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּֽי־יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לָכֶֽם
he.speaker: בְּנֵיכֶם

en.6: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

he.6: לְמַעַן תִּֽהְיֶה זֹאת אוֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּֽי־יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לָכֶֽם׃

en.quote: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
en.speaker: Joshua

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵֽלֶּה
he.speaker: יהושע

en.21: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
